name: Shirahase Fuyuka
source:
A girl who is not just docile and taciturn but also suppresses her own emotions. Because of the complicated situation at home, she wanders the city every night. She has a cute appearance but doesn't recognize it. Negative way of thinking, low self-esteem and the surrounding spiteful atmosphere made her lose her smile. After she meets the protagonist, they start living together. Has a strong tendency towards codependence.

From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kumonosugame/bottlebiosphere-living-with-a-runaway-girl?ref=section-games-projectcollection-6-category]Kickstarter[/url] description.
